book.name: Yon
book.title: Yon Dowan Weng Olo Yone Dolanebuotabe.

content: Yesus esa e ningwal isa i wengobe.
Yesuse inabea blimanoa e Yelusalem bibo deibonea monea Galili betano bib mak bib mako haamonsebe. E Yudia betano mo haanim blimobe. Niminbabe, Yudai komokwali baaniba Ananomabbiobo geib kesotabe.

O dimo Yudai um am temo aala bianiba singka binabib amo dikib tebio kesoa nakaia unangai homoni Yelusalem bib unomo geniba unebibtabe. (v5) Yesuse ningwali e okok sum sumo nabeo mitmakamo tobtlim bianiba i mo tekein kenibta E Gode Dofakamin Nakabo geim blim bianiba
baabaniba Kobo betan olo deiboneba moneba Yudia betan ye unaneba inamin namin okoko mo naneba keb bekebi wateniba Ayamobo geine!

Nakae funanea Nakaia unangai ne inamin namin okoko naia wateniba Ayamobo geine ge funaneme e ayoko mo nanemebabe. Keim ye nanamabebe. Kebsa inanebta keb okoko keim ye nabebta nakaia unangai alukum kateniba Ayamobo geine ge baabasiba
Yesuse baabenea Ne titilo nakaia unangai alebenamabio amo mo tlim blim bio kesoa ne mo unamabibabe. Otane i ibo mo makaa dlablibba kesoa ilib bobol temobe. Enamin dim ota unomo genimibo unaibobe.
Ibole nakaia unangai mo makaa dlanomabibbabe. Nele i kukub misiamo nabibo amitie omkeimaye binabi kesoa i ne klao mo gotne blibbabe.
Ibmaye moniba singkalin amo singkabib ye motemine! Ne onamin amo mo tlim blim bio kesoa ne memalo mo unamabibabo ge baabenea uniba
e Galili teman ye bisebe.
Yesuse monea Yudai um amo singka binabib amo watemsebe.

Yesuse inangge baasea e ningwali deibaniba moniba Yelusalem bibo Yudai um amo singka binabib amo watemnam uniba eka Yesus esak abuk motemsebe. E onse otane keimo mo unim blimobe. E ayok deib motemsebe.
Nakaia unangai Yelusalem bib ye mibianiba singka bianiba falo gamonsiobe. O dimo Yudai komokwali Yesuse hembianiba baaniba E fab biene? ge omonsiobe.
Nakaia unangai ye miblibi i sinwalo ayok baase baase bianiba maki baaniba E naka ayamobo gesib eka maki baaniba E nakaia unangai dim oye binabebo gesib binibbu
otane i keimo mo omin blimobe. Niminbabe, i Yudai komokwali tolo tosiananiba ayok omonsiobe.
I inaniba falo gabianiba aalan metniba isak tem bebibta o dimo Yesuse tanea Gode am sumo daamo tem tam bianea aleyebea
Yudai komokwali ateniba e wengo wenteniba dlou unaniba baaniba Dowe! Naka ele Yuda nib hekmel wengo mo alebaim blim otane e fatnaneta tekein kebene? gesiba
Yesuse baabenea Ne weng ele aleyebi olo nene wengbabe, ne nemane tlibio nakae God eta weng olo omkanebeta aleyebibe.

Nakaia unangai Gode wengo wente bianiba ele weng baaneme iwat nabib ile ne weng ele aleyebi olo tekein kebianiba funaniba Bainobe. E ele bobol temo ni mo oyebebabe. Gode bobol tem funin ota omkahabeta omoneta ni aleyebebo ge funomabiobe.

Nakaia unangai wanita i wengo ili bobol tem funin ota omkeimaib mole i funaniba Naka mak unang maki ni niniino dotouleb nine genibta nanomabiobe. Otane nakaia unangai dlane tlibbio nakae niniino dobtouleb blib ile naka molot unang molotobe. I bobol tem osa dim omin kukubo blimobe.

Mosese hekmel wengo ibo omyebu otane ib isak temo hekmel wengo wafunamin nakai blimobe. Hekmel wengo baanoa Ibo nakai mo yenaiba kaanimibe genobu otane ibo baaniba E Mosese hekmel wengo welanebio kesoa ananoba kaaneko gabiobo ge baabesea
i baabaniba Nakai kobo kananamini blimobe. Kobo hob misiame bekebke bieta weng misiam obeobo ge baabasiba
Yesus esak baabenea Gode singkalin amo dimo ne nakae klaubaia ayam ane kesoa ibo ateniba dlou unibbiobe.

Ibo Mosese hekmel wengo wafu bianiba makob ilib faninwali naniba aalo waketou binibbio inaniba ib meme isa waketouye binabiobe. Ibo Gode singkalin amo dimo memei aalo weketouye binabib olo okok otane ibo mo funanibta Olo Gode singkalin am kesoa memei aalo watlabenamin amo ye tlo otane deibenob sakabta bomasota wetlabenomo ge funa nabibbabe. Yeye ibo Gode singkalin amo dimo funaniba Mosese hekmel wengo olo baanobio iwat nanoba memei aalo wetlabenomo geniba waketouye binabibo osa okok kesoa ne naka ele Gode singkalin amo dimo klaubaia ayam aneo ibo mo nemsuanimibe!
Ibo nakae okoko nanemeo besa kino mo watenibta baanibta E okok olo misiamobo galaibe! Ibo e okoko mitmakamo tekein kenibta okoko ayam nanebe eka misiam nanebe genibta tekein keine ge baabesebe.
I baaniba Naka ele Gode Dofakamin Nakabo gesiobe.
Yelusalem bib seli maki e wengo obeo wenteniba dlou unaniba baaniba Naka ele i Ananomo gabib otane
etemine! E nakaia unangai ayoko mo aleyebebabe. E keim ele aleyebebo, nakai e okoko wataniba tolobo genamin nakai blimobe. Nib komokwali funaniba E Gode Dofakamin Nakabo ge fumbib ese mak otane
e Gode Dofakamin Nakababe. Niminbabe, naka ele bib amo nibo tekein kebuobe. Gode Dofakamin Nakae tlamabeo e bib amo nakai tekein kenamini blimobo ge ohabiba

Yesuse Gode am sumo daamo tem tam bianea aleye bianea weng sum ngananea Ibo ne tekein kebianiba eka ne bib am osa tekein kebib otane ne nene bobol temo mo tlamibabe. Yeye weng moton omin naka eta nemane tlibiobe. Ibo e mo tekein kebibba
otane nele etena bianoba nemane tlibio kesoa e kla tekein kebibo ge baabesea
Yudai komokwali wenteniba baaniba Afunoba klabuto ge debeb unomo geib otane i mo inaim blimobe. Niminbabe, e ananamin amo mo tlim blim kesoa deibasiobe.

Nakaia unangai homoni e bainobo geib kesoa i baaniba Gode Dofakamin Nakae tenea e okok sumo namabeo makob naka ele okok sumo nabe olo ulab anamabo kesoa ni funanoba Naka ele okok kebe ele Gode Dofakamin Nakabo gabuobo ge baasiobe.
Yudai komokwali i okok nakai baabeniba Ibo moniba Yesuse klabuto ge debeb tline ge baabesiobe.

Felisiei nakaia unangai wengo Yesuse ohabibo wenteniba item Gode amo kimanin nakai komokwal ite naniba baaniba Nibo naka maki mo dlanoba moniba Yesuse afuniba klabuto ge debeb tline geniba dlaiba onsiobe.
Yesuse nakaia unangai baabenea Ne ibo amito mo bekebenimibabo, memaloko ye mo bekebe tab unanita yota deibenita imin monia nakae ne nemane tlibue esu unamabibe.
Inanimio ibo ne henomabib otane mo natemomabibbabe. Eka ne bib olo unamabi osa ibo mo unomabibbabo ge baasea
Yudai komokwali i sinwalo baaniba E fab uneta nibo henwa deibanomabbione? E monea nib atuei moniba Glikam ye blib isu unanea Glik teni aleyemang geneta obeso?
E baanea Ibo ne henomabib otane ne mo natemomabibbabo, eka ne bib olo unamabi osa ibo mo unomabibbabo gabe yole weng olo mitmakamo ni no tekein kebobbabo ge baasiobe.
Afen smik aaye wengobe.
Yudai um amo singka binabib amo blimanamabo dimo dot singkalin am sum bomabua Yesuse hana manea amdofa ngambianea Nakaia unangai wanita aan tebo yebo mole teniba nesu tlaniba aaye doweine!
Ne aaye obiamabi ele weng sango Gode buk temo baanoa Nakaia unangai ne bainobo getneib mole afen smik aaye i bobol tem wato biki ut tlanea unemabebo genobiobo ge nganasebe.

Afen smik aaye Yesuse baabanebu ele Gode Hob etabe. Nakaia unangai Yesuse bainobo gabibi Hob ele i bobol temo te was unamabebe. Ina otane yo dimo Yesuse mo kaaneta Gode e titilo ayal inamin einobuo omanea debeb ulanea abilimo mo unim blim bie kesoa Gode e Hobe mo dabane tlim blim bietabe.
Nakaia unangai Yesuse wengo teka bianiba baase baase monsiobe.
Naka homon unang homoni Yesuse weng olo wenteniba maki baaniba Moton Gode weng omkeimalin nakae Mosese ulabe tlamabea ni waisa binabob etabo gesiba
eka maki baaniba Gode Dofakamin Naka etabo gesib eka maki baaniba Yeye Gode Dofakamin Nakae Galili betan dao mo tlamebabe.
Gode buk temo baanoa Gode Dofakamin Nakae Debite molofeite Debite bibo Betlehem bib ye dofanomabiobo ge baanobiobo gesib bianiba
i bobol temo afet afet funmonsiobe.
I ina bianiba maki baaniba Nibo afunoba klabuto ge debeb unomo geib otane i mo afuniba ge debeb unim blimobe.
Yudai komokwali Yesuse mo bainobo geim blimobe.
Omito naka eli imin moniba Gode amo kimanin nakai komokwal isa Felisiei isa isu ye motemiba i baabeniba Ibo nimin kenibta e debeb tenamino deiba tlibe? gesiba
naka eli baabeniba E weng olo ayamobe. Sino nakai inamin wengo mo obinabibbabo gesiba
eka Felisie isak baabeniba Ibo e dim omin weng olo mo wentaibe!
Komokwal isa eka Felisi nisa ni sinwalo e mo bainobo gabobbabe.
Nakaia unangai Mosese hekmel wengo mo tekein kebibba kesoa i Yesuse wengo wentebiobe. Gode i dlanea moniba aseinin bib unomabiobo gesiba
Felisi make, e niniino Nikodimase, sino e kwitimib monea Yesus esu unebio nakae baabenea

Nib hekmel wengo baanoa Nakai besao mo dleb mo daibta klabut animibe! Mikiktemo i wengo wenteniba temiba hekmel wengo waibbiobe genibta dleb mo daibta klabut aine genobio kesoa mikiktemo nibo Yesuse wengo wentenoba e inamin namin misiamo nanebiobe genobte gesea

i baabaniba Kebsa makob e ulab tobtlinin gam kobo Galili da tlebbua? Keb weng olo makob tobtlinin gam ele wengo ulabobe. Gode buk temo baanoa Gode weng omkeimalin nakai Galili da tenamini blimobo genobiobo, kobo Gode weng buko kineba tekein kenale ge baabasiobe.
Taman unango weng sangobe.
[Omito nakaia unangai alukum dli moniba ili am onon tlaniba
